dialogue.chat.jaymoskingdoms.outcry_word: *They're shaking, and keep glancing back over their shoulder.*
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.mugged: Oh! Oh, it's you. Forgive me, I'm all in pieces. Someone just set on me.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.saw_mugged: Did you see it? They were beating someone, right out in the open!
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.saw_thief: Did you see that? A thief, here, in broad sight of everyone!
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.saw_arson: That fire was no accident. I saw who started it!
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.hurt_by_pl: Keep your distance, please. Someone just struck me.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.hurt_by_yo: You! Stay back. You've hurt me enough already.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.hurt_by_fo: Someone I know just turned on me. I can't believe it.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.hurt_by_be: Something set on me just now! I'm still shaking.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.shot: Get down! Something came flying out of nowhere and hit me!
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.burned: Ah, it stings! I got burnt just now.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.fell: Ow... I took a nasty tumble. Give me a moment.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.drowning: I nearly drowned. I can still taste the water.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.blast: What was that blast? My ears are still ringing!
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.freezing: I'm frozen through. I can't stop shivering.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.lightning: The sky came down right beside me!
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.starving: Forgive me, I'm faint. It's the hunger.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.thorns: Ow, ow. Thorns, all up my legs.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.sick: I feel awful. Something's got into me.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.hurt: Something hurt me just now. I don't even know what.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.hostile: Did you see it? There's a %s out there!
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.spooked: Something's out there. I heard it, I know I did.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.opening.cried: You heard me shout? I meant every word.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.mugged: It was %s! Knocked me about and took my purse, bold as you like, right here in the lane.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.saw_mugged: %s set on one of our own for their purse. Beat them till they could barely stand.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.saw_thief: %s had their hand in someone's pack. I saw it plain as day.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.saw_arson: %s set it alight on purpose. I watched them strike the flint.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.hurt_by_pla: %s hit me. No word, no reason, just struck me.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.hurt_by_you: You know what happened. You struck me.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.hurt_by_fol: %s struck me. I've no idea what I did to deserve it.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.hurt_by_bea: It was a %s. It came at me out of nowhere.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.shot: An arrow, or a bolt, I don't know. I never saw who loosed it.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.burned: I got too close to a fire and it caught me. I'll live, but it stings something awful.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.fell: I fell, that's all. Missed my footing and came down hard.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.drowning: I went under and couldn't get back up for air. I thought that was the end of me.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.blast: Something went off right by me and knocked me clean off my feet.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.freezing: The cold got into me. I can't feel my fingers.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.lightning: Lightning! It came down so close I felt it in my teeth.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.starving: There's been nothing to eat. My belly aches with it.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.thorns: I walked straight into the thorns. Silly of me, but it hurts.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.sick: Something's got into my blood. My head's swimming and my stomach turns.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.hurt: I don't know. One moment I was fine, the next I was hurt.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.hostile: A %s, close by! Stay near the lamps, and keep your door shut tonight.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.spooked: I don't know what it was. A sound, a shape in the dark. I just ran.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.answer.cried: What I shouted: "%s" Somebody has to do something.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.after.taken: The guards have them now, thank the gods.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.after.dead: They're dead now. I can't say I'm sorry.
outcry.jaymoskingdoms.after.loose: They ran off. If you see them, don't let them get away with it.
